name: Windows Rule : Suspicious Scheduled Task PowerShell Payload
description: Detects scheduled tasks that execute PowerShell with download functionality and use IEX or Invoke-Expression to execute retrieved content.
author: Johann Weingertner
query:
(
  event.code : 1 AND
  process.name : "schtasks.exe" AND
  process.command_line.text : "/Create" AND
  process.command_line.text : (
    "powershell.exe" OR
    "powershell" OR
    "pwsh.exe" OR
    "pwsh"
  ) AND
  process.command_line.text : (
    "IEX" OR
    "Invoke-Expression"
  ) AND
  process.command_line.text : (
    "Invoke-WebRequest" OR
    "iwr" OR
    "DownloadString" OR
    "DownloadFile" OR
    "OpenRead" OR
    "Invoke-RestMethod" OR
    "irm" OR
    "WebClient" OR
    "Net.WebClient" OR
    "System.Net.WebClient" OR
    "System.Net.Http.HttpClient" OR
    "HttpClient" OR
    "Start-BitsTransfer" OR
    "BitsTransfer"
  )
)
